domain_restrictions: n is a positive integer (so n >= 1)
j is an integer satisfying 0 <= j <= n minus 1 (inclusive)
t is a real satisfying 0 <= t and t < 1
x is a real satisfying x equals T_{n,j}(t)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive integers n and all integers j with 0 <= j <= n minus 1 and all real t with 0 <= t < 1, letting x be the real value T_{n,j}(t), we have both: H_{n,j}(t) equals F_n(x), and H_{n,j}(0) equals F_n(j divided by n).
quantifier_order: for all integers j with 0 <= j <= n - 1
for all real t with 0 <= t < 1
for all real x with x equals T_{n,j}(t)

variables.name: n
variables.role: index parameter for functions T_{n,j}, H_{n,j}, and F_n

variables.name: j
variables.role: sub-index parameter for T_{n,j} and H_{n,j}

variables.name: x
variables.role: auxiliary variable constrained by x equals T_{n,j}(t)

witness_dependencies: x depends on n, j, and t via the defining condition x equals T_{n,j}(t)

statement_nl: For every positive integer n, every integer j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, every real t with 0 <= t < 1, and every real x with x = T_{n,j}(t), one has H_{n,j}(t) = F_n(x) and H_{n,j}(0) = F_n(j/n).
